# SubX Player

> A full-featured video player where subtitles and language learning are first-class.

SubX Player is a full-featured video player for Android and iOS with first-class subtitles and language-learning tools. Watch movies, anime, local files, and streams normally — use dual subtitles, on-device transcription, and practice tools when you want. Watch normally. Learn whenever you want.

Publisher: Abdulhameed ALHINBAZLY
Website: https://www.subx.app/
Contact: ahanbazly@gmail.com

## Platforms

- Android
- iOS
- App UI available in 30+ languages

## Formats

MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, MP3, FLAC, M3U/M3U8 streaming

## Free (SubX Player)

- Full video and audio playback (local files, folders, playlists, streaming)
- Dual subtitle display
- Offline subtitle translation (60+ languages)
- On-device AI subtitle generation (standard model)
- Background playback, picture-in-picture, casting, gestures

## SubX+ (premium; pricing varies by platform and region)

- High-accuracy AI subtitle models (English, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Arabic)
- Subtitle translation into 130+ languages
- Seek by subtitle, auto-pause, auto-repeat
- Sentence mining and subtitle export (SRT, VTT, TXT, PDF)
- Anki export on Android; share subtitle text and audio on iOS
- Ad-free experience

## Technology

- On-device transcription: OpenAI Whisper and Moonshine via sherpa-onnx
- Supported workflows run on your device; your video is not uploaded to generate subtitles

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.androyal.subxplayer
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/subx-player-dual-subtitles/id6747609766
